title: SpaceX首份财报：星链仍是现金牛，AI算力租赁成新引擎
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I mean, overall, revenue and sales came in above consensus.
segments.zh: 总体来看，营收和销售额都超出了市场预期。

segments.en: But you go into this saying, this was the first cordially earnings for SpaceX, since they became a public company.
segments.zh: 但要知道，这是SpaceX上市以来的首份财报。

segments.en: And it will be their first earnings call. And there was a lot of acceptance that the consensus numbers out there, there was a bit of skepticism, right?
segments.zh: 这也是他们的首次财报电话会。市场对共识数据存在不少疑虑，对吧？

segments.en: They're a bit squishy, because we don't have a whole lot of contemporaneous data.
segments.zh: 这些数据有点模糊，因为我们缺乏足够的同期数据。

segments.en: But it's really interesting, the status quo is still that Starlink is the driver on the top line
segments.zh: 但有趣的是，现状依然是星链在拉动营收增长。

segments.en: and also sort of the cash cow. But they really improved the economics of this business in the quarter of, yes, it's a rocket company
segments.zh: 同时它也是现金牛。但本季度他们确实改善了业务的经济效益，是的，这是一家火箭公司。

segments.en: but renting compute capacity to other technology companies.
segments.zh: 但向其他科技公司出租计算能力。

segments.en: That is proved to be a strong business for them. There's a lot of discussion in that in what's a very limited earnings release.
segments.zh: 这对他们来说是一项强劲的业务。在这份非常简短的财报中，对此有很多讨论。

segments.en: Mandy, if I want to bring you in here, if you were to look at the three different segments, the reportable segments, Ed mentioned the cash cow in terms of where the revenue is still coming from.
segments.zh: Mandy，如果你来看这三个可报告分部，Ed提到了现金牛，即营收的主要来源。

segments.en: In terms of growth in your view, which segment is the most important?
segments.zh: 从增长角度看，你认为哪个分部最重要？

segments.en: I mean, they reported a backlog number of 47.5 billion.
segments.zh: 他们公布的积压订单金额为475亿美元。

segments.en: That tells you most of the backlog is likely coming from AI.
segments.zh: 这表明大部分积压订单可能来自人工智能领域。

segments.en: And what is not captured in this print is the entropic and Google deals that they've done.
segments.zh: 而这份财报中并未包含与Anthropic和谷歌的交易。

segments.en: That's okay. That's what I was going to ask you. When you say a backlog, that means companies like Anthropic and Google coming to XAI, part of SpaceX and renting compute.
segments.zh: 好的，这正是我想问的。您提到积压订单，是指像Anthropic和谷歌这样的公司来向SpaceX旗下的xAI租用算力吗？
